narrative: Today's top tech news highlights significant AI advancements, Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen rollout, and a major scandal at Nvidia. The tech and science sectors are abuzz with developments ranging from AI agent deployment to space exploration endeavors.

highlights.title: Nvidia privately confirmed it could track chips to fight smuggling, even as industry publicly questioned feasibility
highlights.whyItMatters: Nvidia confirmed its technical ability to track chips, contrasting with public industry statements on feasibility.

highlights.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
highlights.whyItMatters: Amplitude leverages OpenAI models for proactive product agents, accelerating feature deployment and impact measurement.

highlights.title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
highlights.whyItMatters: Google Search enhances its AI Mode with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, offering more intuitive and visually rich responses to complex queries.

highlights.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Hydrogen, finally replacing 3.8 Flash
highlights.whyItMatters: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen model is rolling out broadly, marking a significant upgrade in AI capabilities.

highlights.title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
highlights.whyItMatters: Nectar introduces an AI agent to streamline influencer marketing, from creator discovery to campaign tracking.

highlights.title: LLMON: An LLM-Native Markup Language, now in Granite 4.1 3B and 8B
highlights.whyItMatters: Hugging Face introduces LLMON, a new LLM-native markup language now integrated into Granite models, enhancing AI model interaction.

highlights.title: Microsoft Outlook is down
highlights.whyItMatters: Microsoft Outlook experienced a global outage due to elevated load on infrastructure across multiple regions.

highlights.title: Google faces calls for AI moratoriums in schools after Gemini pilot backlash
highlights.whyItMatters: Google faces increasing pressure for AI moratoriums in schools following a lawsuit labeling its Gemini pilot a “suicide coach.”
